name: Lost Farm Juicy Peach x Mimosa Live Resin Gummies [10pk] (200mg THC)
description:
A sativa-dominant hybrid strain that blends Clementine with Purple Punch, Mimosa is praised for its citrus rind fragrance and sweet tropical flavor reminiscent of its namesake cocktail.

The Mimosa strain’s bright, sweet and sour citrus flavors are perfectly paired with the tastes of ripe, juicy peach rounded out with a creamy, tart pineapple background.
